Method of Attack: Spreads via infected USB devices containing a malicious .LNK file
Uses msiexec process launched by cmd.exe to execute malicious files
Infects new Windows devices and communicates with command and control (C2) servers
Executes malicious payloads using legitimate Windows utilities: fodhelper, msiexec, odbcconf
Bypasses User Account Control (UAC) using legitimate Windows tools
Attack Vector: Infected USB drives with malicious .LNK files
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious artifacts linked to the worm created in 2019
Communication with addresses on the Tor network
Use of QNAP NAS devices as C2 servers
